episodes.title: Human Flow
episodes.summary: At the onset of a zombie apocalypse, chaos descends as Rose loses her family, Ryan tries to get his bearings, and a desperate man finds a new guise.

episodes.title: Drive
episodes.summary: William, Sun and Barbara try to drive to the stadium, but it's tougher than they thought: They're blocked by both living marauders and roving undead.

episodes.title: Summer School
episodes.summary: Rose, Spears, Ryan and Lance find a refuge. Learning they're not alone, they're schooled on the dangers of following the heart rather than the head.

episodes.title: Alone
episodes.summary: Forced to fend for themselves, the survivors that were left behind must improvise and look out for both the dead and the living.

episodes.title: Diner
episodes.summary: Trapped in an abandoned diner, William and Sun must decide whether they can depend on the survivors from the truck as their alliance is tested.

episodes.title: Heist
episodes.summary: The desperate yet determined group undertakes a daring hit on a weapons stash, but the pandemonium threatens to swallow them up.

episodes.title: The Tunnel
episodes.summary: Soldiers arrive with both plans and promises. But questions remain as a survivor makes a bold move. Who can you trust? Where do your loyalties lie?

episodes.title: The Stadium
episodes.summary: As the group approaches the stadium, everything goes sideways. The survivors blast through their bullets -- and their options.

episodes.title: The Cold
episodes.summary: Life — and death — spins savagely out of control. Familiar faces scramble to survive the brutality, and wrenching betrayal lurks around every corner.

episodes.title: Prelude
episodes.summary: No good deed goes unpunished in a zombie apocalypse: The tables turn for Rose, Sun, Spears and Anna. The winter brings snow — and fresh horrors.

episodes.title: Card Game
episodes.summary: Inside, Rose and Anna are warm, but are they safe? A loose coalition coalesces, but the tension grows, everyone is armed, and an ax has gone missing.

episodes.title: Cold War
episodes.summary: An outgunned Rose must make a life-and-death decision. The war comes home when dangerous groups converge on a haven, catching Sun in the crossfire.

episodes.title: White Horse
episodes.summary: Hungry, hurt and alone, Spears encounters a talkative stranger who claims to know him. A mysterious rider on a pale horse passes in the wilderness.

episodes.title: Currency
episodes.summary: Treasure brings out the worst in everyone, but trust is the most precious commodity in this wasteland. Rose grasps at straws, and Sun risks it all.

episodes.title: The Lodge
episodes.summary: A refuge with hot water, food and all the comforts of civilization feels too good to be true. Rose oversleeps as fear grows and a visitor checks in.

episodes.title: The Plane
episodes.summary: Time for takeoff. Out at the airstrip, old allies reconnect, new cohorts seize the opportunity, and escape seems tantalizingly within reach.
